tools.name: get_credit_options
tools.description: Get current usage prices and the customer account page. This does not create an order, access payment details or authorize spending.

tools.name: get_historical_weather_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve coarse NASA POWER model-derived daily UTC mean temperature and precipitation for provided coordinates and historical date. Sends the coordinates and date to NASA. tools.name: check_french_street_directory
tools.description: Check an explicitly supplied street and city in France against the IGN Géoplateforme address directory. The street and city are sent to IGN for lookup. A current exact directory match does not verify an image, a business, historical existence, or spelling read from a frame; no match is inconclusive.

tools.name: compare_shot_inventory
tools.description: Free deterministic check for shot IDs missing from a supplied inventory, unexpected or repeated IDs, and order. tools.name: compare_lyrics_transcript
tools.description: Free word-by-word comparison of approved lyrics and a transcript of the matching sung or spoken excerpt, supplied by a reviewer or a transcription tool. Reports changed, omitted and extra words. Ignores punctuation and case but preserves accents; Japanese and other languages use word segmentation. T

tools.name: inspect_audio_levels
tools.description: Measure decoded sample levels in a selected 1–30 second section of one video, optionally comparing another video. Reports RMS, peaks, near-full-scale sample counts and one-second windows for listening review. Does not identify a voice, prove clipping, measure perceptual loudness or verify lip sync.

tools.name: measure_region_motion
tools.description: Produce one-second pixel-change measurements in a caller-selected fixed rectangle over 1–30 seconds, for manual review of suspected still backgrounds or other motion. tools.name: prepare_continuity_comparison
tools.description: Extract one labeled frame from each of two completed videos for a vision-capable agent or person to compare a specified continuity concern, such as a character, object position or costume. Accepts public HTTPS videos or attachments. Provides still evidence, not an automated continuity or motion verd

tools.name: check_image_export
tools.description: Check a PNG, JPEG or WebP attachment or public HTTPS image URL against supplied orientation or minimum pixel dimensions. Encoded pixel dimensions may differ from EXIF display orientation. Does not assess sharpness, anatomy, text, content, or creative quality; resizing cannot create missing detail. R

tools.name: compare_reference_audio
tools.description: Compare up to 15 seconds of a video soundtrack with a supplied corresponding audio excerpt. Set videoFromSeconds and referenceFromSeconds when the sections start at different times. tools.name: check_black_gaps
tools.description: Flag nearly black frames in a selected 1–120 second range for manual review. The default minimum is 0.3 seconds; minimumDurationSeconds can be 0.1–3 seconds. Fades, dark scenes and black frames may be intentional; a clear result does not verify the edit. Timestamps refer to the original video.

tools.name: check_full_frame_freeze
tools.description: Find possible freezes in a selected 1–120 second video range or a caller-selected fixed region. Set minimumFreezeSeconds from 0.25 to 5 (default 1); shorter thresholds may flag intentional stills. For longer videos the default is the first 120 seconds; pass fromSeconds and durationSeconds to inspect

tools.name: scan_repeated_shots
tools.description: Experimental visual scan of a selected 4–60 second range. For longer videos defaults to the first 60 seconds; use fromSeconds and durationSeconds to scan another section. Suggests similar two-second ranges for manual review, separating low-motion matches. Timestamps are relative to the original vide

tools.name: check_repeated_sequence
tools.description: Compare two non-overlapping ranges of the same exported video for visual similarity. Returns a candidate and time ranges for human review, not a creative verdict. Does not verify audio, intent or all repetition; never authorizes spending.

tools.name: review_completed_render
tools.description: Use before paying to rerender. Review an exported MP4, MOV or WebM from any renderer. Use a chat attachment or a direct public HTTPS video URL. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "review_completed_render" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
